sections.heading: Susan and Mary on Heat Pumps
sections.body:
Susan Parish wrote: "Always comes same day I call and takes care of my heat pump immediately and completely..
always fair price if any charge at all. The kind of friend to have!" Mary Hunt wrote: "Have had my heat pump for 11 years now, and a common part needed replaced for the first time, and they were out at my place same day, so fast. Great customer service, and my house is cool and dry again. Thank you!"

sections.heading: Options Explained, No Extra Sales Pitch
sections.body:
Christian Hutchinson wrote: "Excellent Service and Reliable Team!

I had a fantastic experience with Brone's Heating & Air! My AC stopped working during a heatwave, and they were able to send someone out the same day. The owner was professional, friendly, and clearly knew what he was doing. He quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything in simple terms, and had it fixed within an hour.

Pricing was fair, and they didn’t try to upsell me on anything I didn’t need. It’s rare to find a company that’s this honest and responsive. I’ll definitely be using them again for all my heating and cooling needs—and recommending them to friends and family!"

sections.heading: Gary and Don in a Heat Wave
sections.body: Gary Selby wrote: "Brad was great. Came out the same day during extreme heat wave. Communicated and diagnosed the issue. Very personable, professional, and will be my guy the next time I need any heat or air conditioning issues! Thanks again!!! Gary" Don Olsen wrote: "Brad actually answered the phone (no voicemail or phone-tag) when I called about our A/C failing and he managed to fit us into his schedule on the same day. He resolved the issue in less than 20 minutes and was on his way to his next job. Thanks for the great work and making sure we didn't sleep another night in the heat."

sections.heading: Bill's Older Home, New System
sections.body: Bill Hancock wrote: "Brad and Richard were outstanding—professional, punctual, and incredibly hardworking. Brad clearly explained the installation process and let me know it would take a couple of days due to the challenges of working in my older home's closet furnace and water heater setup. They went above and beyond to ensure everything was installed properly and working perfectly, and even removed my heavy window unit for me. I couldn't be happier with my new HVAC system and will definitely call Barone for any future HVAC needs. Highly recommended!"

sections.heading: Gail's Old Unit, Gone the Same Day
sections.body: Gail Wacker wrote: "My older HVAC unit died of old age. Barone's Heat&Air llc in Joplin, came to the rescue. Installed a new unit, took care of the old unit in a matter of hours. The only time they left was for lunch break. No running for parts, or tools forgotten. All three men were very knowledgeable and courteous.  Mr Barone explained to me what was happening as they went along, so no surprises. Very happy w the new unit and smooth install."

sections.heading: Monica's Attic, Walls and Floors Intact
sections.body:
Monica Klaurens wrote: "Brad and his crew installed a complete unit, removed and disposed of the old unit, and returned the following day to double check everything was working without issues. Getting to the unit in the attic was a challenge, and they were extremely careful with walls, flooring and doorways.

Price and equipment was competitive, but the service was beyond expectations. All three gentlemen were friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. They went above and beyond, including clearing the drain lines to all my units, cleaning up (including vacuuming) all areas, and answering all my questions.

I highly recommend this small business.

Carl Junction, MO"

sections.heading: Gretchen's Window Unit Overnight
sections.body: Gretchen Goddard wrote: "I can’t recommend Barone’s Heat and Air enough. Brad repaired one AC and replaced another during the hottest days in July. He was prompt with next day service. He even put in a window unit for the night until the unit was installed the next day. Dependable, honest and efficient. Truly went above and beyond."

sections.heading: Jim's Saturday Install After the Heat Failed
sections.body: Jim wrote: "Just our luck our heat went out on one of the coldest days so far so I emailed Barones and within 15 minutes I had a reply asking the problem. I figure it would be awhile before I could get someone to look at it but Brad and his crew were at my house within and an hour. He said my unit was in bad shape . He got it running again but he said he didn’t know how long it would last and he was right an hour later it was down again . So I got back ahold of him and he went over everything with me so we decided we needed to replace the unit. It would take a day to get it shipped to him so he brought us two heaters to get us through. So him and his crew came over on a Saturday morning their day off! which was two days after we lost heat and installed the new unit . Within 45 minutes our house was warm again! I can’t recommend Brad and his team enough. Very professional and super friendly. Thank you Brad and you team!"

sections.heading: A Complicated Older System
sections.body: VolVet03 wrote: "Highly recommend Barone HVAC. Our  home had a complicated older HVAC system with obsolete components that no longer translate to today’s equipment.  Brad came up with the best possible solution for our difficult situation.  Lots of other companies were trying to take shortcuts and still charge us top dollar but Brad shot it to us straight from the beginning and did the job for a price we could afford.  Communication was excellent before and during the project,  he patiently answered all my questions about how this was going to work since we had to make some major changes to the system. For those wondering Barone HVAC is a Goodman dealer and Goodman is known for quality equipment with excellent warranties."

sections.heading: Talk Through a New Unit
sections.body: Call (417) 529-0227. Tell us the age of the system and how the house is laid out. We will walk the job with you before we start.
